program.section_heading: Graphic Design - Associate of Science Degree and Certificate of Achievement - NAS647/C/NCE647
outcomes: Design and create images used for printed media in advertising web design.
Understand and apply the techniques used to create and modify artwork using a vector-based program or bit-mapped program.
Integrate text and graphics in a document layout program to create professional-quality, full-color documents.
Format and combine text, numerical data, photographs, charts, and other visual graphic elements to produce publication- ready material.
Demonstrate the knowledge of workflow process in the creation of printed media in advertising.
Demonstrate the knowledge of design principles in advertising and layout design, type, and lettering applications.
Incorporate two dimensional design visual media of printed media in advertising.

missing_explained.why: not in the text; the catalog lists CAT-78B Advanced Adobe Photoshop instead

notes: The section covers both the A.S. Degree and the Certificate of Achievement with one requirements list and one Program Learning Outcomes list; the A.S. shares both, so they are recorded here.

Each 'Choose one course' group is recorded as one entry with an 'OR' alternative: CIS-66 or CIS-72A (group printed 1.50-3.00 units), CIS-78A or CAT-78A (3.00), CIS-79 or CAT-79 (3.00), CIS-59 or ADM-62 (3.00).

Courses printed after each OR pair (CIS-72B, CAT-78B, CIS-81, ART-22, ART-39, CIS-44) were read as required courses outside the choice, because that reading reproduces the printed total of 26.00-27.50. Reviewer should check: CIS-72B may instead be intended as paired with CIS-72A (CIS-66 or CIS-72A + CIS-72B), which would not match the printed total.
CAT-78B (Advanced Adobe Photoshop) appears where the closed list has CIS 78B with the same title; possibly a cross-listed or renumbered course.
The degree requires general education and graduation requirements per the college catalog, but no GE pattern is named in this text.
